title: UniGFM-RAG: Unify Graph Foundation Models and Large Language Models for End-to-End Retrieval and Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2610.34866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown remarkable capabilities across tasks, but they still struggle with complex reasoning that requires integrating scattered knowledge. Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation (GraphRAG) addresses this challenge by organizing fragment knowledge as graphs, while recent Graph Foundation Models (GFMs) further improve GraphRAG with graph-native retrieval and reasoning capabilities. However, existing GraphRAG methods usually adopt decoupled retrieve-then-generate pipelines, which create objective misalignment between retrieval and reasoning, and training GFM retrievers typically depends on expensive human annotations. To address these limitations, we propose \ourmethod, a unified end-to-end GraphRAG framework that tightly couples a GFM retriever with an LLM generator. translated_title: UniGFM-RAG：统一图基础模型与大语言模型实现端到端检索与推理
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）在各类任务中展现出卓越能力，但在需要整合分散知识的复杂推理方面仍然存在困难。图检索增强生成（GraphRAG）通过将碎片化知识组织成图来应对这一挑战，而近期出现的图基础模型（GFM）则凭借图原生的检索与推理能力进一步提升了GraphRAG的效果。然而，现有的GraphRAG方法通常采用“先检索后生成”的解耦式流水线，导致检索与推理之间的目标不一致，且训练GFM检索器通常依赖昂贵的人工标注。为解决这些局限，我们提出了UniGFM-RAG，一个将GFM检索器与LLM生成器紧密耦合的统一端到端GraphRAG框架。给定一个查询，GFM检索器首先在图上进行推理，对相关文档节点进行评分并检索，随后这些节点嵌入被传入（摘要内容在此处截断）
tldr: UniGFM-RAG提出了一个统一的端到端GraphRAG框架，通过将图基础模型检索器与大语言模型生成器紧密耦合，解决了传统“先检索后生成”流水线中检索与推理目标不一致的问题，同时降低了对昂贵人工标注的依赖。
en_tdlr: UniGFM-RAG proposes a unified end-to-end GraphRAG framework that tightly couples a GFM retriever with an LLM generator, resolving the objective misalignment between retrieval and reasoning in decoupled retrieve-then-generate pipelines while reducing reliance on expensive human annotations.
